import json, urllib.request
base='http://127.0.0.1:18761'
def req(path, method='GET', body=None):
    data=None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode()
    r=urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base+path, data=data, method=method, headers={'content-type':'application/json'} if data else {}))
    return json.loads(r.read())
assert req('/health') == {'status':'ok'}
p=req('/api/projects','POST',{'name':'  lifecycle  '})

t=req(f\"/api/projects/{p['id']}/tasks\",'POST',{'title':'  example task  '})

req(f\"/api/projects/{p['id']}/tasks/{t['id']}\",'PATCH',{'completed':True})
req(f\"/api/projects/{p['id']}\",'PATCH',{'archived':True})
p2=next(x for x in req('/api/projects') if x['id']==p['id'])
assert p2['archived'] and p2['completedCount']==1 and p2['totalCount']==1
req(f\"/api/projects/{p['id']}\",'PATCH',{'archived':False})
assert req(f\"/api/projects/{p['id']}/tasks\")[0]['completed']
print('health, create, completion, archive/restore, summaries: ok')
